ResearchProjectDef.label: archon multi-analyzer
ResearchProjectDef.description: The Archon Multi-Analyzer is an advanced yet inferior imitation of true Archotech technology.\nWhile it cannot compare to genuine Archotech devices, this crafted analyzer significantly boosts research efficiency by 400%.\nUtilizing cutting-edge techniques and materials, it simulates the incredible capabilities of its mysterious predecessors, making it an invaluable tool for any high-tech research facility.
